campos.descripcion:
This gearmotor consists of a high-power, 24 V brushed DC motor combined with a 4.4:1 metal spur gearbox. The gearmotor is cylindrical, with a diameter just under 25 mm, and the D-shaped output shaft is 4 mm in diameter and extends 12.5 mm from the face plate of the gearbox. This gearmotor is also available with an integrated encoder.
Key specifications:
voltage
no-load performance
stall extrapolation
24 V
2300 RPM, 80 mA
2.0 kg⋅cm (28 oz⋅in), 2.7 A
